title: Long list of bands played with
summary: He runs through bandleaders he worked under: King Clayton, Lewis Dorman, Sam Morgan, Joe Howard and others.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Clayton, yeah. King Clayton, yeah. King Clayton, yeah. King Clayton for a while. Mm-hm. And then I played with Lewis Dorman band. Mm-hm. And Auguste Dush . I played with Sam Morgan for a good while. Mm-hm. I played a little while with Joe Howell. And that kid Howell I played with him- I mean Joe Howell I played with him for a little while because he had Frankie Duce in there with him. That's right. The boys wouldn't stick with him on account of Frankie Ducey, we all quit. He had a good band too. The kid Howard, I played with them wrists a little while, you know. Hey, did you know much about Chiff? Chiff? Chiff did. I know it. I know it. Did you play much with him? Yeah, you know, around there, actually, Uri, Uri fired him and his brother, you know. Stomp. Then we used to hire him there. We used to hire him there. Then he left and went to Alexander. And what come old man Paul Bin? Paul Bin? I didn't know what would come of him. He used to play with us sometimes too. Then old man Petit, he used to play with us. Then Morris, you know Morris? French? French, yeah. He used to play with us too sometimes. French, yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
